name: manage_reminders
description: Create, list, or delete reminders for the user. Use this when the user asks to set a reminder (e.g., 'remind me to check the news at 9am daily'), view their reminders, or cancel a reminder.

action.description: The action to perform: 'create' to add a reminder, 'list' to view all, or 'delete' to remove one.

time.description: Required for 'create'. ISO 8601 formatted datetime string for when the reminder triggers (e.g. 2026-04-09T09:00:00Z). Must be in the future.

message.description: Required for 'create'. The message to send the user when the reminder triggers.

repeat.description: Optional recurrence pattern for 'create'. Omit for one-time reminders.

reminder_id.description: Required for 'delete'. The UUID of the reminder to delete, obtained by calling 'list'.
